snippet.title: Gelli Fields Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Support the game on Kickstarter NOW!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wonderpond/gelli-fields-cozy-farming-game

Try out the FREE demo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1965980/Gelli_Fields/

Gelli Fields has been my passion project for nearly three years now. The love and care put into this far outweighs anything I thought I was capable of. This game truly is special to me, and to those who are in the community who engage with the project every day. Thank you to everyone who viewed my videos, who gave me feedback, and who have stuck around through all my shortcomings. Without you this never would have existed, and for that I thank you. Whether you pledge to the project or just lurk and watch my videos you truly make my dreams come true.

-Fairlii
